messages:
alex: Cutting RC candidate from release/1.12.x -> 1.12.3-rc1. Need quick QA ack and pin for the 2h promo window. planning to schedule promo at 15:30 UTC. @beth-qa can you run the smoke checklist?

beth-qa: got it. starting smoke now, will report failures here.

maria: tagging infra — will KV-warm and warm caches after QA green. also can set autoscale bump for canary window.

jamal: heads up — there was a regression in the reranking timeout last cycle. I ran unit repro locally on rc1 branch and fixed the flaky test, but please watch latency during canary.

deploy-bot: [build pinned] artifact=redwood-api:1.12.3-rc1 sha=sha256:9f8e7d scheduled_promo=2026-04-02T15:30:00Z status=queued

beth-qa: smoke results: auth flows ✅, embeddings ✅, streaming ✅, rerank smoke shows increased p95 by ~80ms on a small sample. attaching quick log snippet:
```
2026-04-02T13:02:10Z service.rerank p95=220ms (baseline 140ms)
2026-04-02T13:02:11Z kv.cache hit=87%
```

alex: thanks. Maria / Jamal, can you triage the p95 spike quickly? If we can't rule out infra noise in 20m, we should hold the promo and rollforward plan instead of full promo.

maria: looking at infra telemetry — noisy host in GPU pool 3 during smoke. moving canary to pool 1 for the initial 10% traffic. KV warm scheduled.

jamal: I ran the rerank bench with rc1 on pool1 and p95 is back to 150ms. seems infra-noise. I still pushed a small guardrail tweak to rate limiter that reduces retries, patch is on branch and included in rc1.

alex: OK good. @beth-qa, re-run the smoke on pool1 when ready. If green, we pin and proceed with scheduled promo. If anything else, we'll abort and rollforward.

beth-qa: re-smoke on pool1: all green. no regressions observed. embedding delta within noise. :thumbsup:

alex: signoff from product: :thumbsup: (internalts) 15:08 UTC by alex. Scheduling promo for 15:30 UTC as planned.

deploy-bot: [promo scheduled] artifact=redwood-api:1.12.3-rc1 promo_time=2026-04-02T15:30:00Z steps=[canary(10%)->bump(50%)->full(100%)] rollback_command=`deployctl rollback --to=stable --from=1.12.3-rc1`

oncall-luke: I'll be on-call for the 30->full window. setting pager to "release-sheriff" channel. Please post any post-deploy alerts here and tag me.

alex: release notes snippet to publish in docs/rc-notes: 
- bump: release 1.12.3-rc1
- fixes: flaky unit tests, rate-limiter guardrail
- watch: rerank p95 (observed infra noise during smoke)

maria: preflight checklist done: kv-warm ✅, autoscale bump ✅, pool routing set ✅, circuit-breakers configured ✅.

jamal: small rollback contingency: if rerank p95 > 250ms for 3 consecutive 1-min buckets in canary, deploy-bot should auto-stop and roll back. I added the metrics rule to the promo config.

deploy-bot: [alert rule added] metric=service.rerank.p95 threshold=250ms duration=3m action=auto-stop+rollback

beth-qa: quick note — I flagged one minor doc wording in release notes, won't block.

alex: final signoff from eng: alex ✅, qa: beth-qa ✅, infra: maria ✅, oncall: luke ✅. Proceed with promo at scheduled time.

deploy-bot: [promo started] step=canary target=10% started_at=2026-04-02T15:30:05Z

deploy-bot: [canary update] 10% steady 2m, errors=0, p95=155ms

oncall-luke: seeing healthy canary, no alerts. continuing to 50%.

deploy-bot: [promo update] step=bump target=50% started_at=2026-04-02T15:40:12Z 50% steady 1m, errors=0, p95=160ms

alex: good so far. continuing to full.

deploy-bot: [promo update] step=full target=100% started_at=2026-04-02T15:45:30Z full steady, errors=0, p95=162ms

oncall-luke: release looks clean. rolling post-deploy telemetry checks for next 30m. tagging ops-runbook if anything spikes.

alex: publishing release notes and closing RC thread. If any regressions appear, execute rollback_command above and open a postmortem. Thanks team. :party_parrot:

beth-qa: ack and thanks everyone.
